C5 supports no children maybe, and married. Still residual: the foundational gift by this person and spouse for construction of a building that was part of a larger complex. Could focus on the gift. Or spouse identity? We need exactly ONE. Use claims C5. Local residual should be an evidence objective, not query. "Establish that Ding Lei and his spouse made a foundational gift for construction of a building that was part of a larger complex." That includes relation. But maybe too broad? It is one coherent event: the foundational gift. It doesn't bundle independent? It includes person/spouse gift and building part of larger complex. But Parent Requirement itself is event. We can phrase focusing on foundational gift and its object building. Is that one objective? Yes: establish the foundational gift event. Since C5 already covers spouse and no children? Actually C5 says married but without children; no spouse name. But condition "their spouse ... had no children" is supported partly. We shouldn't ask that. The unresolved part: foundational gift for construction of a building that was part of larger complex. Also which building/complex. We can choose that.

Need JSON: parent_requirement_id R2, mode residual, used_claims ["C5"], local_residual. Must not search query. Low commitment. Could mention person may be Ding Lei? We can use C5. We can use that. But we should preserve uncertainty? Claim asserts. So local_residual: "Establish whether Ding Lei and his spouse made a foundational gift for the construction of a building that was part of a larger complex." That's a question-like objective. Is that allowed? local_residual is an evidence objective, not query. Fine.

Need ensure not add outside. We don't know spouse. Could say "the spouse (if identified)..." But parent says This person and their spouse. C5 says married. So use "Ding Lei and his spouse". Should we not assume Ding Lei is the person? Claim C5 says Ding Lei. Original question asks specific person. Parent says This person. C5 likely about same. Use claims. Fine.

Could also focus on "foundational gift for construction of a building that was part of larger complex" only.
